newsitem.title: CHINA: CATHAY CARGO TASK FORCE PREPARES MOVE TO CLK.
newsitem.headline: CATHAY CARGO TASK FORCE PREPARES MOVE TO CLK.

text.p: A task force has been set up by the cargo department of Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd to oversee the task of moving home to Hong Kong's new airport at Chek Lap Kok(CLK) due to open next April, the airline's in-house newspaper said.
213 operations staff will be first to move into their new base at SuperTerminal One, the world's biggest cargo terminal being built by Hong Kong Air Cargo Terminals Ltd (HACTL).

The remaining 132 head office staff will be based in the Cathay Pacific City headquarters, also under construction at CLK. These staff are not due to move until mid-June or July, after the airport opens and after HACTL closes down its Kai Tak buildings, the newspaper said.
It added that a big challenge will moving more than 700 pallets and containers before Kai Tak closes, while another 700 will be ferried to the new airport after it opens.

"Once the last flight departs from Kai Tak on 31 March until the first flight arrive at CLK on 1 April, every minute will count," the newspaper said. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
